import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static int N, M;
    static List<List<Integer>> G;
    static List<Edge> E;
    static int[] level, work;
    static int src, sink;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;
        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < N && c < M;
    }

    static int idCell(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + M * x + y;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        G.get(u).add(E.size());
        E.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, c));
        G.get(v).add(E.size());
        E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean buildLevels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        level[src] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : G.get(u)) {
                int v = E.get(id).v;
                if (level[v] == -1 && E.get(id).flow < E.get(id).capacity) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long augment(int u, int f) {
        if (f == 0) return 0;
        if (u == sink) return f;
        int i = work[u];
        while (i < G.get(u).size()) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(i);
            int v = E.get(id).v;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
                long pushed = augment(v, Math.min(f, E.get(id).capacity - E.get(id).flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    E.get(id).flow += (int) pushed;
                    E.get(id ^ 1).flow -= (int) pushed;
                    work[u] = i;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            i++;
        }
        work[u] = i;
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinic() {
        long ans = 0;
        while (buildLevels()) {
            Arrays.fill(work, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = augment(src, INF)) > 0) {
                ans += pushed;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int deadline = sc.nextInt();
        deadline++;
        int m = n;
        N = n;
        M = m;

        char[][] sci = new char[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }

        char[][] rea = new char[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            rea[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }

        int[][] danger = new int[n][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(danger[i], INF);
        }

        Queue<int[]> q0 = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (rea[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    danger[i][j] = 1;
                    q0.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q0.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q0.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                    if (valid(nx, ny) && danger[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                        danger[nx][ny] = danger[x][y] + 1;
                        q0.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int nodes = 2 * n * m + 2;
        G = new ArrayList<>(nodes);
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[nodes];
        work = new int[nodes];
        src = 0;
        sink = 2 * n * m + 1;

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (sci[x][y] >= '1' && sci[x][y] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(src, idCell(x, y), sci[x][y] - '0');
                }
                if (rea[x][y] >= '1' && rea[x][y] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(n * m + idCell(x, y), sink, rea[x][y] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (sci[x][y] == 'Y' || sci[x][y] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (rea[X][Y] == 'Y' || rea[X][Y] == 'Z') continue;

                        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][m];
                        Queue<int[]> q1 = new LinkedList<>();
                        q1.add(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        seen[x][y] = true;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!q1.isEmpty() && !found) {
                            int[] cur = q1.poll();
                            int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1], tim = cur[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= danger[cx][cy] || tim >= deadline) continue;
                            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                                    int nx = cx + dx, ny = cy + dy;
                                    if (valid(nx, ny) && !seen[nx][ny] &&
                                        sci[nx][ny] != 'Y' && sci[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                                        tim + 1 <= danger[nx][ny]) {
                                        seen[nx][ny] = true;
                                        q1.add(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found) {
                            addEdge(idCell(x, y), n * m + idCell(X, Y), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
